headline: Global outage takes Copilot and Outlook down for over 24 hours
dek: Microsoft says it was a network problem, not an attack, per El País Tecnología.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The outage
body: A Microsoft network failure took down Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Copilot for over 24 hours, per El País Tecnología and Xataka.
Full recovery was only confirmed on Saturday morning (Xataka).

s3.title: The cause
s3.body: Per El País Tecnología and Xataka:

points.t: A technical fault after a network expansion.
Microsoft denied any link to attacks.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: The reach
body: Xataka logged reports in over 70 countries on Downdetector.
Maersk, UK hospitals and Stanford University were hit (Xataka).

caption.hook: A global outage took Copilot and Outlook down for more than 24 hours.
body: Per El País Tecnología and Xataka, the failure also hit Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive. Microsoft blamed a technical problem after a network expansion and denied any link to attacks or AI agents. Exchange Online went down first and overloaded the services tied to it, per El País Tecnología.

Xataka logged reports in over 70 countries on Downdetector, naming Maersk, UK hospitals and Stanford University among those hit. Microsoft chose to restore service gradually, which prolonged the outage. Xataka notes AWS, Azure and Google Cloud hold over 70% of Europe's cloud market.
caption.cta: Do you rely on a single cloud provider?
